title: Intern- System Planning Summer 2027
location_raw: Pewaukee, WI; Kingsford, MI; Cottage Grove, WI; De Pere, WI
description:
Summary of Responsibilities:

About the Role

Start your career at a Great Place to Work! We’re looking for a Transmission Planning Intern to support our Transmission System Planning team.

Key Responsibilities

As a Transmission Planning Intern, you’ll contribute to efforts that ensure the electric grid meets future energy demands reliably and efficiently. You’ll:
• Use electrical system models to evaluate system performance and future capacity needs
• Support integration of renewable energy resources, energy storage, and other emerging technologies
• Analyze grid scenarios to help shape strategic long-term planning
• Assist with data collection, technical studies, and planning documentation
• Collaborate with engineers to support regional reliability and grid modernization efforts

What You’ll Bring

• A bachelor’s degree student majoring in Electrical Engineering
• Familiar with basic electric theory and power systems concepts
• Interested in learning how long-term system planning impacts grid reliability and clean energy integration
• Curious, analytical, and collaborative
Essential Responsibilities:

Why ATC as an Intern
Purpose-Driven Work
Your work matters. As an intern at ATC, you'll contribute to meaningful projects that help power everyday life and support the future of the electric grid.
People-Centric Culture
We are difference makers. At ATC, you'll work alongside supportive teammates who value collaboration, encourage questions, and are invested in helping you succeed.
Flexibility & Balance
We understand that academics, extracurriculars, and personal commitments are important. Our internship experience is designed to provide flexibility while helping you gain valuable professional experience.
Learning & Development
Internships at ATC are built around growth. You'll gain hands-on experience, receive guidance from experienced professionals, and develop skills that prepare you for future career opportunities.
Real-World Experience
From day one, you'll work on meaningful assignments, participate in team discussions, and contribute ideas that make an impact. We believe the best learning happens through doing.
Innovation in Action
The energy industry is evolving, and ATC plays a critical role in shaping its future. As an intern, you'll gain exposure to industry challenges, emerging technologies, and innovative solutions that support a reliable electric grid.
Connections That Last
Build relationships with professionals across the organization, expand your network, and gain insights into a variety of career paths within the energy industry.
A Shared Future
We're committed to creating an environment where interns can learn, contribute, and thrive. Your ideas, perspectives, and contributions help shape our future while building the foundation for yours.

The pay range for this position is $23-27/hr.  The pay range is a general guideline. Employment offers are evaluated individually and consider qualifications, experience and academic achievements.

title: Sr. Data Engineer
location_raw: Pewaukee, WI; Kingsford, MI; Cottage Grove, WI; De Pere, WI
description:
Summary of Responsibilities:

At American Transmission Company (ATC), data is more than information. It is a strategic asset that helps us operate the electric grid safely, reliably, and efficiently.

We're looking for a Data Engineer who is passionate about building scalable data solutions that transform complex information into actionable insights. If you enjoy designing modern data platforms, developing reliable data pipelines, solving technical challenges, and enabling business users through trusted data, this may be the perfect opportunity for you.
Essential Responsibilities:

ATC embraces flexibility in our work and our workplace, balancing their schedules for the day and the needs of the business. However, this role is not available for remote work in other states and would require relocation to either Wisconsin or the Upper Peninsula of Michigan, within reasonable commuting distance to one of our offices.

What You'll Do
Design and Build Modern Data Solutions
• Develop and maintain scalable data pipelines and integration solutions.
• Design and support enterprise data platforms that enable analytics, reporting, and operational decision-making.
• Create reliable and efficient ETL/ELT processes using modern cloud and on-premises technologies.
• Develop data models and architectures that support business intelligence and enterprise reporting.
Drive Data Quality and Reliability
• Ensure the accuracy, performance, security, and maintainability of enterprise data solutions.
• Support data governance, metadata management, and data quality initiatives.
• Implement monitoring, automation, and continuous improvement practices that increase trust in enterprise data assets.
Partner Across the Organization
• Collaborate with business stakeholders, analysts, architects, developers, and IT teams.
• Translate business needs into technical solutions and actionable data capabilities.
• Communicate complex technical concepts in ways that support business outcomes and informed decision-making.
Advance Innovation
• Evaluate new technologies, tools, and development approaches.
• Help modernize data platforms and improve operational efficiency through automation and innovation.
• Contribute to ATC’s evolving cloud and analytics strategy.

What You'll Bring
Required Qualifications
• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Management Information Systems, Data Science, Software Engineering, or a related discipline.
• Five or more years of experience designing, developing, and supporting production data pipelines.
• Experience building data solutions that support reporting, analytics, and business intelligence.
• Hands-on experience with Python Notebook, Microsoft Fabric and Azure Data Factory.
• Strong Python and PySpark development experience.
• Experience integrating systems through REST and SOAP APIs.
• Experience with Microsoft SQL Server technologies including SSMS, SSIS, SSRS, and SSAS.
• Experience using Git, Azure DevOps, or similar source control and DevOps platforms.
• Experience supporting data governance, data quality, and enterprise data management practices.
Preferred Qualifications
• Experience with data warehouses, data marts, lakehouses, or modern cloud-based data platforms.
• Experience developing CI/CD pipelines and deployment automation.
• Experience with data observability, monitoring, and performance tuning.
• Knowledge of enterprise data architecture and master data management.
• Experience with Microsoft Power BI or comparable analytics platforms.
• Experience working in utility, energy, infrastructure, manufacturing, or other regulated industries.

Why ATC

- Purpose-Driven Work: We’re energized by meaningful and challenging work that contributes to the greater good, from powering everyday life to grid modernization.

- People-Centric Culture: We are difference makers. We lead with trust, value collaboration, and foster a supportive environment where people grow, contribute openly, and make a difference.

- Flexibility & Balance: Our work environment encourages autonomy, connection, and choice with accountability.

- Growth & Development: Curiosity, coaching, and engagement fuel careers.  We invest in our people through cross-functional opportunities, skill-building, and assignments that stretch potential and build careers.

- Comprehensive Rewards: Compensation, benefits, and well-being offerings are thoughtfully and competitively designed to support employees’ unique needs.

- Reliable Innovation: Grounded in the communities we serve, we play a critical role in powering the grid, with the agility to innovate, lead, and drive progress in a time of transformational change in the industry.

- A Shared Future: We commit to creating an environment where people can do their best work, thrive, and drive success for our customers and stakeholders, delivering a lasting impact for all.

Join our Great Place to Work, where we build and operate the power grid that enables modern life, and where every role contributes to something bigger than any one of us.

The targeted base pay for this position is $128,400 to $149,800 annually.*  Base pay is one component of our comprehensive total rewards package which includes an annual incentive bonus, employer-sponsored pension plan, 401(k) match, HSA contribution, life & disability insurance, health care benefits, generous time off plans, flexible work arrangements, and much more .

*The pay range is a general guideline. Employment offers are evaluated individually and consider qualifications, experience, academic achievements, internal equity, and business needs. Pay exceeding the posted range is considered for uniquely qualified candidates. Interested internal candidates, with questions, please consult your Human Resources Business Partner.

title: Manager - System Planning
location_raw: Pewaukee, WI; De Pere, WI; Cottage Grove, WI
description:
Summary of Responsibilities:

Help Build the Grid of Tomorrow
At American Transmission Company (ATC), transmission planning is essential to preparing the electric grid for evolving customer needs, emerging technologies, and long-term reliability requirements. We are seeking a Manager, System Planning to provide strategic, technical, and people leadership for the team responsible for planning ATC's transmission network.

This is an opportunity to influence critical infrastructure investments, advance planning excellence, strengthen compliance, and develop highly technical professionals whose work will shape the future of the grid.
Essential Responsibilities:

You will connect technical planning, enterprise strategy, and people leadership to help ATC make informed decisions about the future of the transmission system. Your leadership will support system studies, project development, capital forecasting, regulatory activities, customer needs, and compliance with reliability standards.

THE LEADERSHIP IMPACT
Coach and empower technical professionals, align priorities and resources, and foster accountability, collaboration, innovation, and succession readiness.

THE SYSTEM IMPACT
Guide planning programs and studies that support transmission reliability, project decisions, regulatory needs, and long-term grid strategy.

WHAT YOU'LL DO
Lead and Develop a High-Performing Team
•  Inspire, coach, mentor, and develop transmission planning professionals.
•  Set clear priorities, align internal talent and external consultants, and balance workloads and financial resources.
•  Build a culture of accountability, collaboration, high performance, innovation, and continuous learning.
•  Support the ATC Strategic Engineering Experience and Development (SEED) program.

Drive Grid Strategy and Planning Excellence
•  Oversee the design, execution, evaluation, compliance, and continuous improvement of planning programs and processes.
•  Direct system planning studies and project development activities, including support for regulatory approval and technical testimony.
•  Advance planning criteria, guidelines, tools, technologies, processes, and documentation.
•  Support capital forecast development and the prioritization of transmission investments.

Protect Reliability and Compliance
•  Maintain strong governance for planning-related NERC reliability standard compliance.
•  Identify planning and compliance risks early and guide appropriate corrective action.
•  Ensure planning work responds to changing customer needs and transmission system reliability requirements.
•  Provide leadership before, during, and after an ATC Ready event when called upon.

Influence Enterprise and Industry Outcomes
•  Represent System Planning in enterprise-wide discussions and champion organizational initiatives.
•  Partner across engineering, operations, asset management, project management, interconnection solutions, customer engagement, and regulatory affairs.
•  Communicate credible planning recommendations to executives, board members, customers, regulators, and industry stakeholders.

WHAT YOU'LL BRING
Required Qualifications
•  Bachelor of Science degree in Electrical Engineering, or equivalent experience in transmission planning or power systems.
•  Eight or more years of experience in transmission system planning, transmission design, engineering, operations, maintenance, or another related technical area.
•  Demonstrated ability to set priorities, manage resources, balance workloads, coach employees, and guide technical programs and projects.
•  Strong understanding of electric power system reliability standards, compliance procedures, and relevant regulatory organizations.
Preferred Qualifications
•  Progressive responsibility leading engineers, technical specialists, consultants, or complex cross-functional work.
•  Experience directing transmission planning studies and supporting project justification or regulatory approval.
•  Ability to explain complex technical matters clearly to executives, board members, customers, regulators, and industry stakeholders.
•  Experience developing capital forecasts, allocating financial resources, or prioritizing technical portfolios.
•  Exposure to FERC, NERC, MISO, PSCW, IEEE, EPRI, CEATI, EEI, NATF, or similar organizations.

Why ATC

- Purpose-Driven Work : We’re energized by meaningful and challenging work that contributes to the greater good, from powering everyday life to grid modernization.

- People-Centric Culture : We are difference makers. We lead with trust, value collaboration, and foster a supportive environment where people grow, contribute openly, and make a difference.

- Flexibility & Balance : Our work environment encourages autonomy, connection, and choice with accountability.

- Growth & Development : Curiosity, coaching, and engagement fuel careers.  We invest in our people through cross-functional opportunities, skill-building, and assignments that stretch potential and build careers.

- Comprehensive Rewards : Compensation, benefits, and well-being offerings are thoughtfully and competitively designed to support employees’ unique needs.

- Reliable Innovation : Grounded in the communities we serve, we play a critical role in powering the grid, with the agility to innovate, lead, and drive progress in a time of transformational change in the industry.

- A Shared Future : We commit to creating an environment where people can do their best work, thrive, and drive success for our customers and stakeholders, delivering a lasting impact for all.

Join our Great Place to Work, where we build and operate the power grid that enables modern life, and where every role contributes to something bigger than any one of us.

The targeted base pay for this position is $171,600 to $200,200 annually.*  Base pay is one component of our comprehensive total rewards package which includes an annual incentive bonus, employer-sponsored pension plan, 401(k) match, HSA contribution, life & disability insurance, health care benefits, generous time off plans, flexible work arrangements, and much more .

*The pay range is a general guideline. Employment offers are evaluated individually and consider qualifications, experience, academic achievements, internal equity, and business needs. Pay exceeding the posted range is considered for uniquely qualified candidates. Interested internal candidates, with questions, please consult your Human Resources Business Partner.
